Resolves #20656

🌿 *From this commit on, the engine no longer calls itself a version it has already shipped.*

This PR makes the bump that `publish.mjs prepare` needs before it can run (#20655, step 1). `package.json` and the lock's two root fields move from 13.3.1 to 13.4.0. `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.3.1.md` leaves in the same commit, because `PublishReleaseNoteOrphan.spec.mjs` refuses any note below `package.json`'s version.

That drop broke the committed Portal release index. It listed only 13.3.1 at `v13.3.1.md`, so the news route fetched a 404 page as markdown, and CI's `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` failed on the first head. The second commit regenerates the index with `buildScripts/docs/index/release.mjs`, the generator `prepare.mjs` runs in the release commit. The index now lists the one note on disk, and its date stays provisional until `prepare` stamps the note. `ServiceWorker.mjs`, `src/DefaultConfig.mjs` and the Portal footer stay at 13.3.1 here; `prepare.mjs` stamps them in the release commit, as it did for 13.3.1 (#20085).

Evidence: L3 (a local Playwright unit run of the release, prepare, package-contents and scope-classifier specs; the Portal e2e folder; `check-relative-links` and `check-package-contents`; all at this head) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-3). Residual: AC-4, Residual-Owner: #20655.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `git diff origin/dev --stat`: `package.json` changes 1 line (13.3.1 → 13.4.0); `package-lock.json` changes 2 lines (the root and `packages[""]`); `releases.json` changes 1 line (`13.4.0` at `v13.4.0.md`); nothing else changes |
| AC-2 | `ls .github/RELEASE_NOTES/` → `v13.4.0.md` only. `v13.3.1.md` is removed in the bump commit; no file links to it (`git grep "RELEASE_NOTES/v13.3.1"` finds nothing) |
| AC-3 | At this head: the release + prepare + package-contents + scope-classifier unit specs pass (46 + 100, `--workers=1`); `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/portal/ --workers=1` → 30 passed; `check-relative-links` OK (340 links); `check-package-contents` OK (6260 files). CI: this PR's required checks |
| AC-4 | Residual: the cross-family review (a Gemini primary, requested once CI is green) and the operator's merge |

## Deltas from ticket
#20656's body was corrected after CI's first run. The index regeneration joined *The Fix*, AC-1 and AC-3, with the reason in *The Problem*.

## Test Evidence
- Red, then the control, for the news route: `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` fails 3/3 at `10bb7b4c5b` ("Markdown component received an HTML document instead of markdown content"). With only `v13.3.1.md` restored on the same tree, it passes 3/3. With the regenerated index, the whole Portal e2e folder passes 30/30.
- The first head's other red, `TearOutMatrixRows4To7NL.spec.mjs:216` (row 5, a 30 s popup timeout), touches neither the version nor the index. It re-runs on this head.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] On `dev` at this merge, `node buildScripts/release/publish.mjs prepare --rehearse --ticket 20657 --body-file <body>` reports every gate ✅ (#20655, step 2).
